thread.title: UPDATE: All 30 Dow stock rise premarket, led by UnitedHealth

author: morningstar.com
title: UPDATE: All 30 Dow stock rise premarket, led by UnitedHealth
text:
Shares of all 30 Dow Jones Industrial Average components were trading higher, as the three companies reporting earnings gave investors reason to cheer. The gainers were leb by the 2.3% jump in UnitedHealth Group Inc (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/unitedhealth-raises-guidance-after-31-profit-rise-2018-04-17).'s stock (UNH) after the insurer beat profit and revenue expectation. Johnson & Johnson (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/johnson-johnsons-stock-gains-after-profit-and-revenue-beat-raised-outlook-2018-04-17)'s stock (JNJ) tacked on 0.8% and Goldman Sachs Group (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/goldman-sachs-blows-through-estimates-2018-04-17-848530) Inc. shares (GS) gained 0.9% after both companies beat profit and sales expectations. Merck & Co. (MRK) shares were the second-biggest gainer, up 2.0%. Among other more active Dow stocks, Apple Inc.'s (AAPL) gained 0.6% and General Electric Co.'s (GE) tacked o 0.5%. Meanwhile, Dow futures (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/dow-futures-rise-100-points-as-traders-cheer-earnings-with-goldman-sachs-on-deck-2018-04-17) rallied 217 points.
-Tomi Kilgore; 1629ET
